messages:
Mike H: Quick heads-up — planning a vendor + submodule lockfile sweep before the v1.8 cutoff. Suggest quiet window Tue 03:00-06:00 UTC. Any blockers?

Elaine C: All good here. I've asked infra to pre-warm builders. I'll try to land the node-snap transitive fix before the window; will flag if infra can't scale.

Prajit S: I have an open submodule change (gh#542) that conflicts with vendor/openssl sha. Can rebase but prefer to target release branch instead of main.

Mike H: Plan: cut release/v1.8 at cutoff. Open lockfile/vendor bump PRs against release/v1.8 or cherry-pick into it — please don't merge straight to main during the window.

Linda M: Changelog folks — I'll aggregate. Please prefix PRs with `chore(deps):` and add a one-line summary in the PR body. I'll run the generator post-cutoff.

Prajit S: CI failing on my PR:
```
Error: vendor checksum mismatch
Expected: a1b2c3d4
Actual:   f9e8d7c6
Run: make vendor-check
```
I'll re-sync vendor and force-push in ~10m (aiming for 1718500612).

ci-bot: check/vendor on pr#542 failed — logs: https://ci.redwood/abcd1234. Retry with `ci retry` after vendor changes are pushed.

deploy-bot: Reminder — deploy window Tue 03:00-06:00 UTC. Autoscale and scheduled crons will be muted. For a hot deploy, ping @Mike H.

Mike H: Lockfile bump checklist:
- branch off release/v1.8
- run `scripts/vendor-sync --ensure-checksums`
- run `make vendor-check`
- add `release-plan: v1.8` label

Example:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/v1.8-deps-<yourname>
scripts/vendor-sync --ensure-checksums
make vendor-check
git commit -am "chore(deps): vendor bump"
git push origin HEAD
```

Elaine C: :thumbsup: I'll smoke infra after vendor PRs land and report here.

Prajit S: pushed fix at 1718500612 — CI re-run queued. pinging reviewers: @Elaine C @Linda M

Linda M: noted, I'll pick changelog blips from PRs labelled `release-plan: v1.8`. If you want a manual blurb, DM me.

Mike H: If something goes sideways during the quiet window, mark PR `rollback-candidate` and call oncall. Otherwise we'll proceed with the cut.

Elaine C: Copy that — thanks everyone.
